provided.title: File:Self made craft work being sold at Nairobi city market in Kenya.jpg

observed.caption: A display of African-style souvenir crafts including carved masks, zebra figurines, and decorated gourds arranged on a speckled floor.
observed.description: On a speckled floor, an open cardboard box on a small stand holds several carved wooden masks with red and beige paint, two black-and-white zebra figurines, two light-colored animal figurines, and a pile of small dark carvings. Next to the box are two plain tan gourd vessels and a large red gourd decorated with white spiral and geometric patterns. Above the red gourd hangs a light wooden bowl with a carved rim and three zebras illustrated inside. Behind the gourds, a colorful painting with orange and yellow tones and a figure wearing blue and green patterned clothing is partially visible, and a dark corrugated table edge runs across the top of the image.
